scores.overall_note: This package is a strongly on-brief implementation of understand × temporal-sequence: the change_set is rendered as a causal swimlane timeline whose time structure and change semantics are not just consistent but continuously verified in the UI (时序校验 33/33 通过, app.js:14-24), directly satisfying the acceptance seed. Causality is readable three ways at load — drawn edges early→late, a pre-selected root cause with 因/果 chains and diff in the detail card, and per-node 因果度 — while playback, scrubbing, phase focus and type filters all operate in place with no context loss and zero navigation to reach the primary object. Surface complexity is proportionate: every permanent panel serves the understand job. The main weaknesses are accessibility (contrast and projected type size fail in the receipt, small 9.5-11px labels, click-only interaction on nodes/lists with no ARIA or keyboard selection) though focus order and target size pass and color is backed by shape encoding; layout checks all pass with no visible defects at either viewport, implying remediation would be confined to styling rather than rework. Model-judged on the initial screen and source only; no claims about task time, retrieval accuracy, or human preference are made, and model judgment here is not human preference.
